evals.name: partner-orders-api-contract
evals.prompt: Review openapi.yaml and the orders endpoints for an external partner API. Fix the contract and list breaking changes.
evals.expected_output: Consistent error shape/status codes, cursor pagination, idempotency for POST, documented authz, versioning/deprecation, and a list of breaking changes.
assertions: Flags errors returned with HTTP 200 and inconsistent error shapes
Requires one consistent error schema and correct status codes
Adds idempotency for order creation and retries
Replaces or bounds offset pagination with cursor pagination
Identifies breaking changes for existing clients
